title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

what.description: IntroWhat(...) panel: what the topic is.

roadmap.description: Optional preview of the sections ahead, as RoadmapStep references.

estimatedTime.description: Optional time to complete, e.g. "25 min".

moduleCount.description: Optional number of modules shown in the header.

displayTitle.description: Optional title shown inside the card instead of `title`.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

Intro.description: Topic opener: what it is, why it matters, and a roadmap of the sections ahead. `displayTitle` overrides the title shown inside the card.

IntroWhat.description: The "what is it" panel of a topic intro.

summary.description: One-paragraph answer to "why does it matter?".

IntroWhy.description: The "why it matters" panel of a topic intro.

title.description: Name of the upcoming section.

type.description: Section type it previews, e.g. "quiz" or "flowchart".

description.description: What the learner will do there.

sectionId.description: Optional section file name (without .oui) to link to.

RoadmapStep.description: A roadmap entry previewing a later section. `type` is the section type (e.g. "quiz"); `sectionId` its file name.

what.description: What this section shows, in one sentence.

why.description: Why it matters to the learner.

next.description: What the learner should do or look for next.

Lead.description: Short lead-in shown above a section: what it shows, why it matters, and what comes next.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

paragraphs.description: The paragraphs, one string each, in order.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

Text.description: Prose section: one string per paragraph.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

Bullets.description: Bulleted (or numbered, when `ordered` is true) checklist.

children.description: Optional nested bullets, as Bullet calls.

Bullet.description: A bullet point, optionally with nested child bullets.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

TaxonomyBrowser.description: Browsable taxonomy of categories with scope, analogy and details.

title.description: Category name shown on the card.

icon.description: lucide-react icon name, e.g. "Brain" (falls back to a circle).

color.description: Accent colour: blue, peach, pink, mauve, green, teal, sky, lavender, yellow or red.

details.description: Longer explanation shown in the category details.

primaryFocus.description: The main concern of this category, in one line.

outOfScope.description: What does not belong here (and often where it goes instead).

TaxonomyCategory.description: A category card in a taxonomy browser. `color` is a theme color name (e.g. "blue", "mauve").

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

images.description: The images, as GalleryImage references, in order.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

id.description: Image ID, unique within the gallery.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

layers.description: The rows, top to bottom, as Layer references.

blocks.description: Blocks placed on the grid, as MatrixBlock references. Together they must fill the grid without gaps.

description.description: Optional summary shown above the map.

displayTitle.description: Optional title shown inside the map instead of `title`.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

PillarLayer.description: Layer-stack map: layers as rows, blocks placed on a gap-free grid. `displayTitle` overrides the title shown inside the map.

id.description: Layer ID, unique within the map; blocks refer to it with `layer`.

title.description: Layer name shown at the start of the row.

items.description: Optional items listed for this layer, as LayerItem references.

Layer.description: A horizontal layer (row) of a pillar/layer matrix.

title.description: Item name.

LayerItem.description: A labelled item listed inside a layer.

id.description: Block ID, unique within the map; `dependsOn` refers to it.

title.description: Text shown on the block.

layer.description: Anchor row: Layer reference or ID.

rowSpan.description: Optional number of rows covered, downward (default 1).

description.description: Optional detail shown when the block is selected.

color.description: Optional accent: rosewater, flamingo, pink, mauve, red, maroon, peach, yellow, green, teal, sky, sapphire, blue or lavender.

dependsOn.description: Optional IDs of blocks this block depends on.

shape.description: Optional "rect" (default) or an L-shape inside the span: "l-bottom-left", "l-bottom-right", "l-top-left", "l-top-right".

offsets.description: Optional custom shape: [rowOffset, colOffset] cells relative to the anchor. Overrides spans and shape.

MatrixBlock.description: A block placed on the matrix, anchored at `layer` (reference or ID) and `colOffset`. Spans default to 1; `shape` is "rect" or an L-shape. `dependsOn` lists block IDs.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

actors.description: Human actors, as Actor references. Each must start at least one step.

systems.description: Systems, as System references. Each must handle or receive at least one step.

steps.description: The flow, as Step and Branch references, in order.

journeys.description: Guided paths through the flow, as Journey references.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

Flowchart.description: Animated Event Storming flowchart. Every actor and system must be used by at least one step.

id.description: Actor ID, unique within the flowchart; steps refer to it with `initiatedBy`.

title.description: Actor name shown on its sticky (e.g. "Buyer").

desc.description: What this actor is or wants.

Actor.description: A human actor (user role) who initiates steps.

id.description: System ID, unique within the flowchart; steps refer to it with `handledBy` / `delegatesTo`.

title.description: System name shown on its sticky (e.g. "Order Service").

desc.description: What the system owns or does.

kind.description: Optional "aggregate" (owned domain model) or "external" (outside service). Default "external".

stateMachine.description: Optional StateMachine(...) for a system that orchestrates the flow.

System.description: A system that handles commands: an "aggregate" (owned domain model) or an "external" service.

StateMachine.description: State machine for an orchestrating system. `initialState` is a state ID.

id.description: State ID, unique within the state machine.

label.description: State name shown in the state machine view.

color.description: CSS colour for the state, e.g. "var(--ctp-green)" or "#a6d189".

MachineState.description: A state of a system state machine.

id.description: Step ID, unique within the flowchart; journeys and `continuesAs` refer to it.

policy.description: Policy that reacts to the incoming event ("When …"); the POLICY sticky.

command.description: Command the policy issues, in imperative form (e.g. "PlaceOrder").

handledBy.description: System that handles the command (System reference or ID).

events.description: Events the handler emits, as Event references (past tense).

initiatedBy.description: Optional actor that starts this path (Actor reference or ID), usually on the first step.

delegatesTo.description: Optional second system the handler calls (System reference or ID).

continuesAs.description: Optional ID of the Step, Branch or BranchOption that this path's events lead into.

description.description: Optional narration of this step, shown when it is highlighted.

sendsTo.description: Optional actor or system that receives this step's events (e.g. the server sends ServerHello to the client).

Step.description: Linear Event Storming step: POLICY → COMMAND → handledBy system → resulting events. `initiatedBy` is the actor that starts it; `delegatesTo` a system the handler calls; `sendsTo` the actor or system that receives its events.

id.description: Event ID, unique within the flowchart.

title.description: Event name in past tense (e.g. "Order Placed").

Event.description: A domain event produced by a step (past tense, e.g. "Order Placed").

id.description: Branch ID, unique within the flowchart.

event.description: The event that splits into the options (e.g. "Payment Checked").

Branch.description: Branching step: one event splits into several policy/command paths.

id.description: Option ID, unique within the flowchart; journeys and `continuesAs` refer to it.

label.description: Label drawn on the branch edge (e.g. "approved").

policy.description: Policy that reacts to the incoming event ("When …"); the POLICY sticky.

command.description: Command the policy issues, in imperative form (e.g. "PlaceOrder").

handledBy.description: System that handles the command (System reference or ID).

events.description: Events the handler emits, as Event references (past tense).

dashed.description: Optional: true draws this path as a dashed line (e.g. an error path).

initiatedBy.description: Optional actor that starts this path (Actor reference or ID), usually on the first step.

delegatesTo.description: Optional second system the handler calls (System reference or ID).

continuesAs.description: Optional ID of the Step, Branch or BranchOption that this path's events lead into.

description.description: Optional narration of this step, shown when it is highlighted.

sendsTo.description: Optional actor or system that receives this step's events (e.g. the server sends ServerHello to the client).

BranchOption.description: One path of a branch: label, then the same POLICY → COMMAND → system → events cycle as a Step.

id.description: Journey ID, unique within the flowchart.

label.description: Journey name shown in the journey picker (e.g. "Happy path").

steps.description: The stops in order, as JourneyStep references.

Journey.description: A guided path through the flow, from start to finish.

step.description: The Step or BranchOption this stop plays (reference or ID).

name.description: Short stop name shown in the journey list.

description.description: Narration shown while the stop is played.

processGroup.description: Optional phase used by the state machine (e.g. "planning", "execution").

JourneyStep.description: A stop on a journey: the Step or BranchOption it plays (reference or ID), with a short name and narration. `processGroup` groups stops for the state machine (e.g. "planning", "execution").

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

id.description: Scenario ID, unique within the topic.

intro.description: Optional setup text shown before the first node.

startNode.description: Optional ID of the first node (default "start").

displayTitle.description: Optional title shown inside the scenario instead of `title`.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

Scenario.description: Branching "what would you do?" scenario. `startNode` defaults to "start". `displayTitle` overrides the title shown inside the scenario.

id.description: Node ID, unique within the scenario; choices point at it with `next`.

prompt.description: Situation and question shown at this node (prompt nodes).

outcome.description: Outcome(...) ending (outcome nodes, instead of prompt/choices).

ScenarioNode.description: A scenario node: a prompt with choices, or an outcome.

id.description: Choice ID, unique within its node.

text.description: Choice text shown on the button.

next.description: ID of the ScenarioNode this choice leads to.

ScenarioChoice.description: A choice in a scenario. `next` is the ID of the node it leads to.

verdict.description: Short judgement of the path taken (e.g. "Solid call").

lesson.description: What the learner should take away.

Outcome.description: End of a scenario path: verdict, lesson, and rating ("a", "b-plus", "b-minus" or "c").

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

TradeoffSandbox.description: Interactive sandbox where learners make design choices and watch metrics move.

id.description: Scenario ID, unique within the sandbox.

title.description: Scenario name shown in the scenario picker.

metrics.description: Metrics to watch, as TradeoffMetric references.

steps.description: Decisions in order, as TradeoffStep references.

TradeoffScenario.description: A trade-off scenario: metrics to watch and the sequence of decisions to make.

id.description: Metric ID, unique within the scenario; choices refer to it in `metrics`.

label.description: Metric name shown on its bar (e.g. "Latency").

baseValue.description: Starting value before any choice is made.

min.description: Optional lowest value the bar shows (default 0).

max.description: Optional highest value the bar shows (default 100).

direction.description: Optional "higher" or "lower": which way is better.

TradeoffMetric.description: A metric tracked across a trade-off scenario. `direction` says whether higher or lower is better.

id.description: Step ID, unique within the scenario.

title.description: The decision to make at this step.

recommended.description: Optional ID of the recommended choice.

TradeoffStep.description: A decision point in a trade-off scenario. `recommended` is the ID of the recommended choice.

id.description: Choice ID, unique within the step; `recommended` refers to it.

label.description: Option name shown on the choice card.

metrics.description: Delta per metric ID when picked, e.g. {performance: 10, cost: -5}.

whyThisFits.description: Optional reason this option fits the scenario.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when to choose this option in practice.

TradeoffChoice.description: One option in a trade-off step. `metrics` maps metric IDs to the delta this choice applies, e.g. {performance: 10, cost: -5}.

title.description: Short pro or con statement.

ProCon.description: A pro or con of a trade-off choice.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

FormulaSandbox.description: Parameter sandbox: sliders drive live formula-based metrics.

id.description: Variable ID, used by name inside formulas (letters, digits, _).

FormulaVariable.description: A slider input that formulas can reference by `id`.

id.description: Metric ID, unique within the sandbox.

label.description: Metric name shown on its card.

formula.description: JavaScript expression over variable IDs, e.g. "Math.round(chunk_size * (1 + overlap / 70))".

analogy.description: Optional everyday analogy shown in the metric details.

inScope.description: Optional list of what the metric covers.

outOfScope.description: Optional list of what the metric does not cover.

FormulaMetric.description: A computed metric. `formula` is an expression over variable IDs, e.g. "Math.round(chunk_size * (1 + overlap / 70))".

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

id.description: Tree ID, unique within the topic.

displayTitle.description: Optional title shown inside the guide instead of `title`.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

DecisionTree.description: Interactive decision guide. `root` is the ID of the first node. `displayTitle` overrides the title shown inside the guide.

id.description: Node ID, unique within the tree; choices point at it with `next`.

prompt.description: Question asked at this node (question nodes).

leaf.description: DecisionLeaf(...) recommendation (leaf nodes, instead of prompt/choices).

DecisionNode.description: A decision tree node: either a question with choices, or a leaf recommendation.

id.description: Choice ID, unique within its node.

text.description: Answer text shown on the button.

next.description: ID of the DecisionNode this answer leads to.

rationale.description: Optional reason for taking this branch.

recommended.description: Optional: true highlights this answer as recommended.

DecisionChoice.description: An answer that moves to another decision node. `next` is the target node ID.

recommendation.description: The recommended option at the end of this path.

tradeoffs.description: Optional list of trade-offs to keep in mind.

DecisionLeaf.description: Terminal recommendation of a decision tree.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

challenges.description: The challenges, as SequenceChallenge references, in order.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

ReflectionSequence.description: Sequence-builder reflection: learners put steps in the right order.

prompt.description: Instruction shown above the items, e.g. "Put the steps in order".

items.description: The items to order, as SequenceItem references, in the order they are first shown (not the solution order).

solution.description: The same items (references or IDs) in the correct order.

SequenceChallenge.description: Ask the learner to order items. `solution` lists the items (references or IDs) in the correct order.

id.description: Item ID, unique within the challenge; `solution` refers to it.

text.description: Text shown on the draggable card.

icon.description: Optional icon name (reserved; not shown yet).

SequenceItem.description: A draggable item in a sequence challenge.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

challenges.description: The challenges, as TemplateChallenge references, in order.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

ReflectionTemplate.description: Self-explanation reflection: learners complete sentence templates with chips.

template.description: Sentence with {zone-id} blanks, e.g. "A cache trades {zone-1} for {zone-2}."

chips.description: Chips the learner can drop into blanks, as Chip references (may include distractors).

solution.description: Correct chip per blank: an object of zone ID → chip ID, e.g. {"zone-1": "chip-a"}.

explanation.description: Optional explanation shown once the template is solved.

TemplateChallenge.description: Fill-in-the-blanks self-explanation. `template` contains {zone-id} slots; `solution` maps each zone ID to a chip ID, e.g. {"zone-1": "chip-a"}.

id.description: Chip ID, unique within the challenge; `solution` refers to it.

text.description: Word or phrase shown on the chip.

Chip.description: A word chip the learner drops into a template blank.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

questions.description: The questions, as QuizQuestion references, in order.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

id.description: Question ID, unique within the quiz.

choices.description: Answer options, as QuizChoice references. Exactly one is correct.

hint.description: Optional hint the learner can reveal before answering.

QuizQuestion.description: A multiple-choice question. Mark exactly one choice as correct.

id.description: Choice ID, unique within its question (e.g. "a").

text.description: Answer text shown on the option button.

correct.description: true for the one correct choice of the question.

explanation.description: Feedback shown after this choice is picked: why it is right or wrong.

QuizChoice.description: One answer option of a quiz question, with the explanation shown after answering.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

cards.description: The cards, as Flashcard references, in deck order.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

Flashcards.description: Deck of flip cards for key vocabulary.

id.description: Card ID, unique within the deck.

word.description: The term on the front of the card.

pronunciation.description: How to say the term, e.g. "/ˈkæʃ/".

category.description: Grouping shown as a badge on the card (e.g. "concept").

shortDefinition.description: One-line definition shown on the back.

detailedDefinition.description: Longer explanation shown on the back.

whyItMatters.description: Why the learner should care about this term.

image.description: Optional image URL or path shown on the card.

dialogue.description: Optional Dialogue(...) example that shows the term in use.

Flashcard.description: A vocabulary flip card: the term on the front, definitions on the back.

user.description: What the user says, using the term.

aiThoughts.description: The AI's internal reasoning about the user's message.

aiQuestion.description: The follow-up question the AI asks back.

Dialogue.description: Example exchange showing a term in use: what the user says, what the AI thinks, and its follow-up question.

title.description: Section title, shown in the topic outline and as the section header.

links.description: The edges between concepts, as ConceptLink references.

heading.description: Optional sub-heading shown under the section title.

lead.description: Optional Lead(...) intro card: what the section shows, why it matters, what comes next.

ConceptMap.description: Knowledge graph of concepts and the relations between them.

id.description: Concept ID, unique within the map; links point at it.

title.description: Label shown on the node.

category.description: Optional node colour group: pattern, mechanism, concept, role, system, data or process.

Concept.description: A node in a concept map.

label.description: Optional relation label drawn on the edge (e.g. "uses").

ConceptLink.description: A labelled relation between two concepts (references or concept IDs).

title.description: Topic title shown in the catalog and topic header.

category.description: Catalog group the topic is listed under.

description.description: One- or two-sentence summary shown on the catalog card.

sections.description: The sections in reading order, as SectionRef calls.

tags.description: Optional keyword tags for search and filtering.

isNew.description: Optional: true shows a "new" badge in the catalog.

Topic.description: Topic manifest (root of topic.oui): catalog metadata and the ordered list of sections.

name.description: Section file name without .oui, e.g. "intro" for sections/intro.oui.

SectionRef.description: Includes the section file sections/<name>.oui of this topic.

topics.description: The topics in catalog order, as TopicRef calls.

Catalog.description: Content catalog (root of index.oui): the ordered list of topics.

id.description: Topic folder name under the content root.

TopicRef.description: Includes the topic folder <id>/topic.oui in the catalog.
